extraction_notes: Digitised main-text performance figures from page images. Figures 1, 2 are apparatus/characterisation and Figures 10, 11 are model-predicted coverages, so they were skipped. For Figure 4b, several K/Ba-promoter series overlap closely; to avoid wrong series assignments, only the clearly identified Cs/Ru = 0.3 series was fully recorded here. Model/equilibrium curves in Figures 7–9 were not digitised. Some axes and markers are small; all plotted values are approximate with qualifier '~'.
